;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]; [[Afghan peace process]]
**A [[Taliban]] spokesman announces the release of 20 [[government of Afghanistan|government]] prisoners [[prisoner exchange|in response]] to the latter's release of 300 Taliban prisoners since Wednesday. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-afghanistan-taliban/taliban-to-release-20-afghan-government-prisoners-on-sunday-spokesman-idUSKCN21U06G (Reuters)]
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**[[Republic of Yemen Armed Forces|Yemeni troops]] recapture a strategic military base on the island of [[Socotra]] from the separatist [[Southern Transitional Council]] (STC). STC forces, which seized control of the base on February 18, fled before the operation began. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20200412-yemeni-government-forces-take-control-in-socotra-island/ (Middle East Monitor)]
*[[Kashmir conflict]]
**An exchange of artillery fire between [[India]] and [[Pakistan]] across the [[Line of Control]] (LoC), kills three civilians, including a child, in Indian-administered [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], according to Kashmir Police Chief [[K. Vijay Kumar]]. [[Pakistan Army]] general [[Babar Iftikhar]] says two Pakistani civilians are injured. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2020-04-12/shelling-across-pakistan-india-border-kills-three (''U.S. News & World Report'')]

;Arts and culture
*Today [[Pope Francis]] livestreames the [[Urbi et Orbi]] blessing for the second time in just a month. Usually given on Christmas and Easter, this year the pope also gave the blessing on March 27, during a special prayer service for the end of the [[Coronavirus|coronavirus]].  [https://cruxnow.com/vatican/2020/04/on-an-easter-under-quarantine-pope-calls-resurrection-a-contagion-of-hope/ (CRUX)]

;Business and economy
*[[2020 Russia–Saudi Arabia oil price war]]
**[[OPEC]] and allies strike a deal to cut oil production by 9.7 million barrels per day, the largest such cut agreed upon, starting May 1. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-52264546 (BBC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Easter tornado outbreak]]
**A tornado outbreak occurs in the [[Southeastern United States]]. [[Mississippi]] declares a [[tornado emergency]]. [https://weather.com/safety/tornado/news/2020-04-12-severe-weather-outbreak-south-east-tornadoes-damaging-winds (Weather)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] reports 220 new confirmed cases and 50 more deaths from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the country's death toll to 297 with 4,648 total cases. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-philippines-cases/philippines-reports-highest-single-day-death-toll-from-coronavirus-idUKKCN21U08R (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****Former [[Chief Rabbi of Israel]] [[Eliyahu Bakshi-Doron]] dies from COVID-19 at [[Shaare Zedek Medical Center]] in [[Jerusalem]]. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2020-04-12/former-israeli-chief-rabbi-dies-after-contracting-coronavirus (''U.S. News & World Report'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saba]]
****The first confirmed case of COVID-19 is reported on the [[Dutch Caribbean]] island of [[Saba (island)|Saba]]. [https://masnoticia.com/saba-a-registra-prome-caso-di-corona-virus-y-a-dal-un-lockdown-di-biaha/ (Mas Noticia)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****The death toll from coronavirus in [[Italy]] has reached 19,889 people. Italy has the second highest number of deaths in the world, after the [[United States]]. [https://www.corriere.it/salute/malattie_infettive/20_aprile_12/coronavirus-italia-156363-casi-positivi-19899-morti-bollettino-12-aprile-9cf2b856-7cd0-11ea-9e96-ac81f1df708a_preview.shtml?reason=unauthenticated&cat=1&cid=x9KYtzJ7&pids=FR&credits=1&origin=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.corriere.it%2Fsalute%2Fmalattie_infettive%2F20_aprile_12%2Fcoronavirus-italia-156363-casi-positivi-19899-morti-bollettino-12-aprile-9cf2b856-7cd0-11ea-9e96-ac81f1df708a.shtml (''Corriere della Sera'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] is released from hospital after days in [[intensive care]]. [https://www.orlandosentinel.com/coronavirus/ct-nw-boris-johnson-coronavirus-20200412-l5iyf2jqprgaxdxfsnhsmwh6je-story.html (''Orlando Sentinel'')]
****The [[Department of Health and Social Care]] reports 737 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the [[United Kingdom|UK]]'s death toll to 10,612. The UK becomes the fourth country in Europe, after [[Italy]], [[Spain]] and [[France]], to surpass 10,000 deaths from COVID-19. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/coronavirus-uk-deaths-hospital-update-england-latest-today-news-a9461551.html (''The Independent'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Somalia]]
****Justice Minister of [[Hirshabelle State]], Khalif Mumin Tohow, becomes the second person to die from COVID-19 in [[Somalia]]. The state minister recently travelled back from the United Kingdom. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20200412-somali-state-minister-dies-of-coronavirus-in-mogadishu/ (Middle East Monitor)]
